items.title: The points specializing to a constructible subset, minus the subset, form a spectral space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a constructible subset of a spectral space, the set of points specializing to it with the subset removed is spectral and is described as a limit of the differences inside the quasi-compact opens (author lemma at source lines 5285-5294, label lemma-make-spectral-space-minus). The proof (source lines 5296-5306) applies the limit description to the set of specializing points, notes that each difference is spectral by the constructible-closed statement and concludes by spectrality of limits (proof lines 5296-5305). The identification of the difference with the limit is the substance. H3.
